findings.evidence: At the start of every fix round, in either mode, increment $FIX_ROUND ... (block below; new rounds only, never on a resume ... yet at 4 or more still take the floor below)
findings.fix: Split the block: increment only when this is a new fix round; on a resume or Step-2 re-entry at FIX_ROUND >= 4, skip the increment and go straight to references/escalation.md's floor.

findings.evidence: 10 should-trigger and 12 should-not-trigger queries, but no recorded trigger-rate runs
findings.fix: Keep the 22 queries; add a short note of a trigger-rate run (3 runs, pass threshold) beside the file so the set is maintained, not only authored.

findings.fix: Add a one-line description and one example per subcommand to the parser so --help is the agent's interface, matching using-scripts.md.

findings.fix: Guard the increment block with the same condition the prose states, and point the resume path at references/escalation.md without running it; following the block as printed double-counts a restored round.
